page_title: New Molecular Entities Approved in 2010 by CDER (FDA PDF, Last Refresh Date 1/3/2011)
row_count_note: 15 NME NDAs + 6 BLAs = 21 novel approvals; matches FDA's official 2010 count of 21.

rows.indication: INDICATED TO IMPROVE WALKING ABILITY IN PATIENTS WITH MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS (MS). THIS WAS DEMONSTRATED BY AN INCREASE IN WALKING SPEED.
INDICATED AS AN ADJUNCT TO DIET AND EXERCISE TO IMPROVE GLYCEMIC CONTROL IN ADULTS WITH TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS
INDICATED FOR LONG-TERM ENZYME REPLACEMENT THERAPY (ERT) FOR PEDIATRIC AND ADULT PATIENTS WITH TYPE 1 GAUCHER DISEASE.

INDICATED FOR USE IN PEDIATRIC AND ADULT PATIENTS AS AN ADJUNCTIVE THERAPY FOR THE TREATMENT OF ACUTE HYPERAMMONEMIA DUE TO NAGS DEFICIENCY. AND AS MAINTENANCE THERAPY FOR CHRONIC HYPERAMMONEMIA DUE TO NAGS DEFICIENCY.

rows.applicant: CHEMISCHE FABRIK KREUSSLER AND CO GMBH
rows.indication: INDICATED TO TREAT UNCOMPLICATED SPIDER VEINS (VARICOSE VEINS <= 1MM IN DIAMETER) AND UNCOMPLICATED RETICULAR VEINS (VARICOSE VEINS 1 TO 3 MM IN DIAMETER) IN THE LOWER EXTREMITY. [FDA PDF prints 'VARICOXE' for the second occurrence; recorded corrected as verbatim-approximation noted here.]
INDICATED FOR PREVENTION OF PREGNANCY
INDICATED FOR THE TREATMENT OF PATIENTS WITH HORMONE REFRACTORY METASTATIC PROSTATE CANCER PREVIOUSLY TREATED WITH A DOCETAXEL-CONTAINING TREATMENT REGIMEN.

INDICATED FOR THE PREVENTION OF ITCHING ASSOCIATED WITH ALLERGIC CONJUNCTIVITIS. [FDA PDF prints established name 'VILASTA OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION'; the established name on Drugs@FDA is alcaftadine ophthalmic solution. Verbatim flag.]

INDICATED FOR THE PREVENTION OF PREGNANCY FOLLOWING UNPROTECTED INTERCOURSE OR A KNOWN OR SUSPECTED CONTRACEPTIVE FAILURE. ELLA IS NOT INTENDED FOR ROUTINE USE AS A CONTRACEPTIVE. [FDA PDF prints 'FLOWING' for 'FOLLOWING'; verbatim flag.]

rows.brand: Gilenya [FDA PDF prints 'FINGOLIMOD HCL ORAL CAPSULES' in the proprietary-name column; brand name per Drugs@FDA]
rows.indication: INDICATED FOR THE TREATMENT OF PATIENTS WITH RELAPSING FORMS OF MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS TO REDUCE THE FREQUENCY OF RELAPSES AND TO DELAY THE ACCUMULATION OF PHYSICAL DISABILITY.
INDICATED TO REDUCE THE RISK OF STROKE AND SYSTEMIC EMBOLISM IN PATIENTS WITH NON-VALVULAR ATRIAL FIBRILLATION

rows.brand: Latuda [FDA PDF prints 'LURASIDONE HCL' in the proprietary-name column; brand name per Drugs@FDA]
rows.indication: INDICATED FOR THE TREATMENT OF SCHIZOPHRENIA IN ADULTS

rows.brand: Teflaro [FDA PDF prints 'CEFTAROLINE FOSAMIL FOR INJECTION' in the proprietary-name column; brand name per Drugs@FDA]
rows.indication: INDICATED FOR THE TREATMENT OF ACUTE BACTERIAL SKIN AND SKIN STRUCTURE INFECTIONS AND COMMUNITY ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA. [FDA PDF prints 'RACTERIAL'/'STURCTURE'; corrected here with verbatim flag. Cerexa = Forest Laboratories subsidiary.]
INDICATED FOR THE REDUCTION OF EXCESS ABDOMINAL FAT IN HIV-INFECTED PATIENTS WITH LIPODYSTROPHY

rows.brand: Halaven [FDA PDF prints 'ERIBULIN MESYLATE' in the proprietary-name column; brand name per Drugs@FDA]
rows.indication: INDICATED FOR THE TREATMENT OF PATIENTS WITH METASTATIC BREAST CANCER WHO HAVE PREVIOUSLY RECEIVED AT LEAST TWO CHEMOTHERAPEUTIC REGIMENS FOR THE TREATMENT OF METASTATIC DISEASE. [FDA PDF prints 'FOR FOR'; corrected here with verbatim flag.]
PROVIDES TREATMENT FOR REDUCING SIGNS AND SYMPTOMS IN ADULT PATIENTS WITH MODERATELY TO SEVERELY ACTIVE RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS.
PROVIDES TREATMENT OF ADVANCED DUPUYTREN'S DISEASE
PROVIDES TREATMENT OF NON-INFANTILE-ONSET PATIENTS WITH POMPE DISEASE
PROVIDES TREATMENT FOR PREVENTION OF OSTEOPOROSIS IN POSTMENOPAUSAL WOMEN
PROVIDES TREATMENT OF CERVICAL DYSTONIA

PROVIDES FOR THE TREATMENT OF CHRONIC GOUT IN ADULT PATIENTS REFRACTORY TO CONVENTIONAL THERAPY.
